/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sympy as S
c,q,s=S.symbols('c q s', real=True, nonzero=True)
h=s+1/s
K=h+2
z=(K*c*c-h)/2
E=S.Matrix([[c,q],[-q,c]])
C=S.Matrix([[c*c-q*q/s,(1+1/s)*c*q],[-(1+s)*c*q,c*c-s*q*q]])
def circle_reduce(expr):
    num,den=S.fraction(S.cancel(expr))
    return S.factor(S.rem(num,S.Poly(q*q+c*c-1,q),q)/den)
checks={}
checks['determinant']=circle_reduce(C.det()-1)==0
checks['trace']=circle_reduce(S.trace(C)-2*z)==0
checks['initial_g1']=circle_reduce((E*C)[0,1]-q*(2*z+1/s))==0
checks['matrix_recurrence']=all(circle_reduce(v)==0 for v in C*C-2*z*C+S.eye(2))
a,b,d,e=S.symbols('a b d e')
B=S.Matrix([[a,b],[d,e]])
checks['general_2_by_2_identity']=all(S.expand(v)==0 for v in B*B-S.trace(B)*B+B.det()*S.eye(2))
checks['h_strictness_identity']=S.factor(h-2-(s-1)**2/s)==0
checks['pullback_lower_bound_identity']=S.factor((h-2)/(h+2)-((s-1)/(s+1))**2)==0
checks['n1_root_formula']=S.factor(K*(s/(s+1))**2-s)==0
checks['R1_rotation']=all(S.expand(v)==0 for v in C.subs(s,1)-S.Matrix([[c*c-q*q,2*c*q],[-2*c*q,c*c-q*q]]))
for name,passed in checks.items():
    print(f'{name}: {\"PASS\" if passed else \"FAIL\"}')
assert all(checks.values())
print('Exact symbolic identities only; uniform root-count proof audited separately.')
PY"
